author: Limidi
body:
A TALE OF 2 Towns. By Limidi.


A Tale Of Two Towns in a CTF map By Limidi. It is loosely based off of The battle of 5 armies in The Hobbit. It is 15v15, but that can change. not Finished, Leave suggs down below. Also, I need help with XML. THANKS! There are many treasures and hidden easter eggs in this map, and a series of tunnels. The floating mountains are for background, but they are playable :D.





Backstory: Coming Soon

Igmur Album: http://imgur.com/a/umWGs

Download:  http://www.mediafire.com/file/wjjv878xxw65927/Avicus_Map.zip

XML: Not finished/ need help

replies.author: benaye
replies.body:
I'm not even going to give you a + or a - 1 because I'm sorry but this map is made very poorly. Big thumbs down.

Work on:

Structure (mountains should be closer in and the towns should be further apart)
Mountains (at the moment they are useless, maybe have like some iron there or something.
Flag (It's too in the open with nothing over or around it except a few measly trees)
Decoration (while the map outside looks lovely and detailed the inside grassy bit is extremely bland and lacks quite a lot of detail.

Add those and then submit it to me.
